judgement_by: Hon. S. Devika De Livera Tennekoon, J
keywords: Criminal appeal – Murder – Death sentence – Common intention – Assault with bricks and rafters – Deceased pelting stones at temple – Deceased apparently intoxicated – Accused called to assist in removing intruder – Accused originally unarmed – Absence of premeditation – Absence of murderous intention – Grave and sudden provocation arising from prosecution evidence – Duty of trial judge to consider mitigatory defence even if not expressly pleaded – Lesser culpability – Murder conviction and death sentence set aside – Conviction substituted for culpable homicide not amounting to murder – Seven years rigorous imprisonment each – Fine – Appeal allowed.
legistation: Code of Criminal Procedure Act No. 15 of 1979 – section 331; Penal Code – sections 32, 294, 296 and 297.
